name: Zenith
tagline: I build small systems where software meets hardware.
about: I’m Chingsangamba, a CSE undergraduate into systems programming, robotics, automation and low-level software. Most projects start as small experiments: tools I need, or ways to understand how things work. I also tinker with language technology for Manipuri (Meiteilon), my native language. I use Arch, btw.
